title: The portal: the wire projection, the snapshot over the logbook, and a plain read-only face on each environment's Worker
summary: Every environment's Worker now answers /portal (HTML) and /_portal/v1/* (JSON) from the one bundle of a revision. generated/portal/blueprint.json is the portal's wire: schemaVersion 1, the model, the generated docs, each operation's proof dependencies and a sha256 digest, deterministic (no clock, no revision). @architect/portal rejects an unknown schema or a digest mismatch, reads the logbook's open routes, and judges every operation in every environment: recorded-pass, failed (the latest failure wins), stale (naming the changed declarations and both hashes), unproven, or unavailable when the logbook is down, slow, inconsistent or lacks the model. Only a recorded pass is a tick. env up gives the Worker the logbook's address; prove --env test now keeps the revision's model in the logbook, which the portal judges verdicts against.
proves: On the real logbook (workerd under wrangler) holding verdicts signed by a real OIDC server in Docker, over models the real compiler wrote: spend shows test ✔ staging ✔ production ✔; a budget edit makes spend stale in staging and production and no other operation; the latest failure wins and a later pass replaces it; a pull request's signed verdict never fills the matrix; a verdict whose revision has no model, a logbook that stops, and a ledger that will not hold still each show nothing green. On a copy of acme under git, staging's and production's own workerd serve /portal from the built bundle with the data routes, the old bundle still stale-judged against the newer test revision, the logbook's address in no page, env down leaving nothing running. The portal's JSON dependency adapter equals Compare.dependsOn on acme, acme with a list read, the compiler's recorded snapshot of acme and the starter; the portal is imported by generated/portal/main.ts only. The author's check 8 passes its first portal assertion and stops at architect watch (L2.09); its portal steps pass in the real flow with the watch steps taken out. Lint, typecheck, sync check, every project's tests, acme's and the starter's prove, and tools/e2e/starter.sh pass.

captions.01-fails-first: The done-when tests before the code (or with the piece they test set aside): missing modules, rows not found, a 404 for the model.
captions.02-done-when-tests: The done-when tests passing: portal (wire, snapshot, site, real logbook), generators (projection and Compare), prove (/portal on a real environment, the model kept).
captions.03-author-checks: The author's check 8 verbatim (stops at architect watch), its portal half in the real flow, and what the run found: promote straight after build is refused, and a pooled fetch socket does not survive a restart.
captions.04-workspace-checks: Lint, typecheck, sync check, every project's tests, and local prove of acme and the starter.
captions.05-starter-e2e: tools/e2e/starter.sh: the starter, the way a user gets it, with @architect/portal published and installed.
